metadata.title: Cosmological rigidity via $p$-harmonic temporal functions
metadata.abstract: We prove a splitting theorem for cosmological spacetimes which admit a globally $p$-harmonic Cauchy temporal function for some $p < 1$, without making any use of timelike lines. In Bartnik's context of cosmological and timelike geodesically complete spacetimes, we establish a Liouville-type unboundedness result which shows that globally $p$-harmonic temporal functions, $p < 1$, are necessarily Cauchy temporal. Moreover, using the theory of elliptic PDEs, we show that locally Lipschitz $p$-harmonic temporal functions with $p < 1$ are in fact smooth. Altogether, our work reduces the resolution of Bartnik's cosmological splitting conjecture to the global weak solvability of the $p$-d'Alembert equation for some $p < 1$ in the class of locally Lipschitz temporal functions.

analysis.workSummary: 在宇宙学时空中，若存在某个p<1的全局p调和Cauchy时间函数，则证明分裂定理，论证不使用类时直线。在Bartnik所研究的宇宙学且类时测地完备背景，证明全局p调和时间函数的Liouville型无界性，从而其必为Cauchy时间函数；又由椭圆PDE理论证明局部Lipschitz的此类函数实际光滑。于是将Bartnik宇宙学分裂猜想约化为局部Lipschitz时间函数类中的某个p<1的p-d’Alembert方程全局弱可解性。
techniques: 椭圆正则性与弱解约化
analysis.breakthrough: 以全局时间函数方程替代类时直线的存在性，为分裂猜想提供新的条件化解决路线。
analysis.limitations: 全局弱可解性仍是待解决条件，不能写成已证明Bartnik猜想；摘要未展开宇宙学时空的能量及因果约定，需正文确认。p<1为关键Lorentz型指数范围。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
